name: kopai
description: Investigate production issues with your OpenTelemetry traces, logs and metrics in Kopai: root-cause analysis through the hosted Kopai MCP server, plus dashboards and instrumentation help through the Kopai SDK and CLI (these need a Kopai token in .kopairc). It never changes a system it monitors; it writes only what you ask for, such as a dashboard, instrumentation code or an alert rule you approved.
